target_pattern: Use simple present as default for current actions, habits, near-future plans with time markers, and polite requests, while limiting unnecessary progressive constructions.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Overusing progressive and future forms where Spanish prefers simple present.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Spanish present tense covers now, routine, near-future with markers, and polite request frames naturally.
target_pattern_formula: simple present for now and general current action
present plus frequency marker for habits
present plus future time marker for near future
me plus present verb for polite request
present with motion verbs, voy/viene, for immediate action
natural_examples: Maria limpia la casa los sabados.
Me pasas la sal, por favor?

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Yo camino a la escuela todos los dias. -> change subject to nosotros.
Base: Ahora entiendo la respuesta. -> change subject to ella.
Base: Manana salimos para el aeropuerto. -> change time marker to hoy.
Base: Me ayudas con esto? -> change to formal usted.
Base: Voy al banco. -> make it negative.
Base: Me dices la hora, por favor? -> change to plural polite request, ustedes.
Base: El siempre toma te por la noche. -> change adverb to nunca and keep present tense.
Base: Visitas a tus abuelos este fin de semana? -> change to statement with yo.
Base: Me pasas el cuaderno, por favor? -> change object to la sal.
Base: Mis amigos vienen a mi casa despues de la escuela. -> change subject to singular mi amigo.
Base: Nosotros cenamos a las siete todas las noches. -> change to question.
Base: Te llamo manana. -> change direct object pronoun to le formal.
Base: Empiezas manana tu nuevo trabajo? -> change to statement with nosotros.
Base: Ella se levanta a las seis todos los dias. -> change to plural ellas.
Base: Tenemos que salir temprano manana. -> change to yo.

prompts: I walk every day. (Camino todos los dias. vs Estoy caminando todos los dias.)
Tomorrow we leave early. (Manana salimos temprano. vs Manana saldremos temprano in this lesson target style.)
Can you help me? (Me ayudas? vs Me estas ayudando?)
I am going to the store. (Voy a la tienda. vs Estoy yendo a la tienda, default conversational preference.)
What are you doing? (Que haces? vs Que estas haciendo? where simple present is preferred in this lesson.)
He comes to my house every Friday. (Viene a mi casa cada viernes. vs Esta viniendo a mi casa cada viernes.)
Could you pass me the salt? (Me pasas la sal? vs Me pasaras la sal?)
We eat at seven. (Comemos a las siete. vs Estamos comiendo a las siete, habitual meaning.)
Do you start tomorrow? (Empiezas manana? vs Empezaras manana? in this lesson target style.)
Can you lend me a pen? (Me prestas una pluma? vs Me prestaras una pluma?)

common_errors.correct_spanish: Present plus time marker is natural in Spanish.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Direct mapping from I am going.
Not adjusting tu vs usted verbs.
Unclear intent now vs routine vs near future.

common_errors.correct_spanish: Simple present often sounds more natural.
